{| id="{{{id|{{lc:{{<includeonly>subst:</includeonly>PAGENAMEE}}}}}}}" class="darkbackground1 messagebox" style="border:2px solid {{{border|#BBD}}}; border-radius:5px; border-spacing:0px; padding:0px; background-color:{{{bg|#EEF}}}; overflow:hidden"
| style="padding:10px; text-align:center" | {{{image|}}}
| style="padding:10px 10px 10px 0px; width:100%; font-style:italic; {{{messagestyle|}}}" | {{{message|}}}
|}<noinclude>
__NOTOC__
==Description==
A '''medium-sized message box''', generally used as a [[:Category:Copyright templates|copyright notice]] inside the {{Tl|Information}} template on a file page.

==Usage==
<pre>
{{MediumMB
|border=
|bg=
|image=
|message=
}}
</pre>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|image}} The image to include on the left-hand side of the box, such as <code><nowiki>[[File:Copyright-red.svg|50px]]</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|message}} The written message on the right-hand side of the box.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|id}} The [[wikipedia:HTML|HTML]] <code>id</code> attribute of the box, which defaults to the template name in lowercase.
*{{Para|border}} The box border color, default <code style="padding:0 5px; border:2px solid #BBD; border-radius:5px">#BBD</code>.
*{{Para|bg}} The box background color, default <code style="padding:0 5px; background:#EEF; color:#000">#EEF</code>.
*{{Para|messagestyle}} Any additional [[wikipedia:CSS|CSS]] styling for the message text, such as <code>text-align:center</code>.

==See also==
